_comment: Flogit reviews. Every delivered Flogit order gets 1–5 stars and a comment a few working hours after the courier collects it (delay_hours). Score = base + the factors that apply + noise, rounded and clamped to 1–5. overgraded: the grade on the listing was better than the unit really was (a flaw the grader missed). fast: dispatched within fast_hours working hours of the sale. late / very_late: dispatched after the deadline (very late = very_late_hours or more). bargain / pricey: price paid vs the guide for the unit's TRUE grade. battery: laptops/tablets/phones below battery_below %. worn_grades: buyers of worn kit are a touch harsher. rep: reputation nudge per star. Comments are picked from the strongest reason; placeholders {thing} {grade} {flaw} {flaw_lc} {model} {price}.

overgraded: Listing said grade {grade}. My nan's reading glasses are in better nick. ({flaw})
Lovely {thing}, apart from the bit nobody mentioned: {flaw_lc}.
Grade {grade}? Grade 'having a laugh', more like. {flaw}.
Specs as described. Condition, not so much — {flaw_lc}.
If that's grade {grade}, I'm the King of Belgium. {flaw}.
very_late: Ordered it for my daughter's first term. She's graduated.
Arrived that late I'd already bought another one. Now I've got two.
Posted by carrier pigeon, I assume. A tired one.
Took longer than the roadworks on the A64. Never again.
Three working days late and not a word. Shocking.
late: Took that long I'd forgotten I'd ordered it.
Arrived eventually. My beard grew an inch waiting.
Good {thing}. Shame it came via the scenic route.
Dispatch slower than a Monday morning.
Fine once it turned up. Emphasis on 'once'.
battery: Battery lasts about as long as a Year 9 attention span.
Works great, plugged in. The battery's more of a suggestion.
Have to sit next to a socket like it's 1998.
Battery dies faster than my phone at a festival.
pricey: Nice kit, but I paid new-car-smell money for it.
Does the job. Wallet's still in recovery.
Bit steep, but it works, so I'll stop moaning. Mostly.
Pricey for what it is. Mum says I got done.
Saw the same thing cheaper the day after. Typical.
fast: Arrived before I'd finished my tea.
Ordered at lunch, here by teatime. Witchcraft.
Quicker than my broadband. Cracking seller.
Blink and you'd miss the courier. Superb.
Posted same day and packed like the crown jewels.
So quick the dog didn't have time to bark at the van.
bargain: Proper bargain. Don't tell the other half what I paid.
Cheaper than a night out in Leeds and lasts a lot longer.
At that price I bought one for my brother-in-law. He's still not grateful.
Absolute steal. Feel like I should check it's not nicked.
Bargain of the year. Would flog with again.
great: Exactly as described. Would flog with again.
Mint condition, works a treat. Ta very much.
Better than the one my work gave me. Don't tell IT.
Spotless. Packed better than my last house move.
Five stars. Would give six but the form won't let me.
Smells faintly of new. Lovely stuff.
good: Does what it says on the tin. Ta.
Good {thing}, good seller, good grief that box had a lot of tape.
Solid. Minor wear, as described. Happy.
Arrived safe and sound. Kids already fighting over it.
No complaints, and I always have complaints.
ok: It's fine. It's a {thing}. It does {thing} things.
Middle of the road. Like a Ford Mondeo.
Not bad, not amazing. A very British three stars.
As described, give or take. Fair enough.
poor: Meh. Bit of a let-down, if I'm honest.
Arrived. Switched on. That's about the best I can say.
spares: Sold as spares, arrived as spares. Honest seller.
Bought it to tinker with. My shed is now a hospital ward.
Exactly as broken as advertised. Respect.
